title: Tech Trends Discussion with Alex
content: Met Alex at Global Tech Innovators Conference. Discussed various emerging tech trends such as AI advancements, quantum computing, and blockchain applications. Agreed to follow up with an email.

title: TechSolutions Executive Meeting Notes
content: Meeting with CEO Mr. Thompson and CFO Ms. Rivera on 2023-01-15. Discussed potential acquisition by MegaCorp and the strategic implications for our projects. Key points included the valuation of TechSolutions at approximately $3.5 billion, potential cultural integration challenges, and the roadmap for product integration post-acquisition.
